comment: Known-good shape for an episodic memory recall result, delivered as a CoreChatStreamEvent of type 'recall' over the turn NDJSON stream (GET /api/chat/turns/{id}/stream). Mirrors TS RecallEventPayload (coreBridge.ts) wrapping RecallHitPayload[]. Each hit carries its grant/policy/revision attestation for linked-memory access. scope is 'personal' | 'project'. status is optional (absent on legacy persisted events).
